title: Compliance-Aware Predictive Process Monitoring: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach
content:
arXiv:2603.26948v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Existing approaches for predictive process monitoring are sub-symbolic, meaning that they learn correlations between descriptive features and a target feature fully based on data, e.g., predicting the surgical needs of a patient based on historical events and biometrics.
